problems: The program has never published a resident roster or graduates list on any program-side host (WRAMC, NNMC, USU, WRNMMC SharePoint, walterreed.tricare.mil), so all 16 years are unobservable from program pages; every year is a significant gap. Complement per year not stated on any page (null). Live walterreed.tricare.mil returns 403 to scripted fetches (not bypassed). Common Crawl pass (prefixes mil,tricare,walterreed)/about-us/graduate-medical-education, .../academics/graduate-medical-education, .../health-services/hospital-care-surgery/neurosurg, mil,capmed,wrnmmc)/researcheducation/gme/sitepages/neurological, mil,capmed,wrnmmc)/health%20services/surgery/surgery/neurosurgery) completed only CC-MAIN-2012 through CC-MAIN-2014-49 (only department Home.aspx records, no roster); one lookup failed (CC-MAIN-2014-10 walterreed.tricare.mil neurosurg range error); the run was killed after ~20 min with CC-MAIN-2015-06 through CC-MAIN-2026 unfinished - phase 2 may retry, though Wayback shows the same pages carry no roster. Phase 2 must rely on non-program sources (e.g. USU/Navy/Army news releases, NPPES, PubMed affiliations, AANS/CNS, social media) to build this roster. PHASE 2: roster rebuilt only from non-program sources. Military authors in WR Dept of Neurosurgery papers include staff trained elsewhere (Mayo, UF, UTSA, Ohio State, Temple), USU medical students, and Georgetown residents on rotation, so an affiliation alone never confirms an NCC resident. Only ORCID/NPPES statements were accepted. OpenAlex returned HTTP 429 at times (retried). Domain-wide Wayback CDX for dvidshub.net/health.mil/navy.mil/army.mil timed out; narrower prefixes were used instead. Phase-2 Common Crawl retry (walterreed.tricare.mil about-us/academics GME + hospital-care-surgery/neurosurg, wrnmmc GME neurological prefixes): CC-MAIN-2015-06..CC-MAIN-2016-50 checked, 0 records (none of these prefixes were in those crawls); failed lookups CC-MAIN-2015-06 (walterreed about-us GME, wrnmmc GME), CC-MAIN-2015-40 (walterreed about-us GME), CC-MAIN-2016-30 (walterreed academics GME); run killed after ~35 min, CC-MAIN-2017-04..2026 not reached. Low yield: Wayback has every version of these pages and none carries a roster.
